ordering: Priority within each repository; not fabricated cross-repository hard dependencies. Bind actual prerequisites before claiming.

actions.title: Resolve the live instruction contract
actions.work: Find the accepted restoration decision, map account-default files and profile destinations, and update only authorized contradictory pointers.
actions.acceptance: One role and allowed-action statement; actual user-profile/default-file consumers verified.

actions.title: Qualify reusable defaults
actions.work: Check links, issue templates, security contact, supported default files and inheritance on an unrelated subject without overwriting its own files.
actions.acceptance: Known-bad links/templates fail; intended consumers receive the expected defaults.

actions.title: Publish a truthful account surface
actions.work: Coordinate with KooshaPari and PhenoRegistry owners; retain a minimal publisher rather than another portfolio database.
actions.acceptance: Exact published source and links validated by the owning reviewer.

actions.title: Repair the real assurance verdict
actions.work: Use separate supported-profile unit/integration/E2E reports, approved denominators, real artifact retrieval and explicit missing/below-floor failure. Reuse existing trusted coverage parsers rather than handrolling weak counters.
actions.acceptance: Injected missing, wrong-SHA and below-floor reports fail. Critical obligations are complete; accepted independent floors are actually enforced.

actions.title: Qualify current command and state behavior
actions.work: Exercise REPL comments, interrupted commands, two unrelated subject repositories, state persistence, MCP transitions and materialized views with exact engine receipts.
actions.acceptance: CLI/MCP operate on the intended Git root; restart and negative authorization cases pass without cross-subject state.

actions.title: Deliver the actual selected release
actions.work: Build/install the promised CLI and desktop profile outside the checkout; capture update/rollback and a useful work lifecycle.
actions.acceptance: Distributed artifact identity, clean install and actual end-to-end evidence; no unbuilt product surface certified by a CLI-only build.

actions.title: Verify native launch and logging
actions.work: Run the actual packaged app from a clean profile outside the repository in debug/release where supported; test single initialization and usable diagnostic output.
actions.acceptance: No initialization panic, no duplicated/missing required logs, no secret exposure.

actions.title: Close one deployment path
actions.work: Connect a real permitted repository, build, provision, observe health/logs, update and roll back on one supported target.
actions.acceptance: A real service responds; failed provisioning and failed updates leave known recoverable state.

actions.title: Exercise current shared dependencies
actions.work: Coordinate runtime/manifest packages with PhenoShared and test cache-isolated source resolution and actual consumer behavior.
actions.acceptance: No reliance on a deleted path, warm Cargo cache or adjacent developer checkout; contract-compatible migration evidence.

actions.title: Return actual work coordinates
actions.work: Report current branch/worktree, artifact, active task and any work outside this repository; reconcile public snapshot versus private producer responsibilities.
actions.acceptance: Exact worker receipt distinguishes local, published, integrated and installed state.

actions.title: Qualify the current distributed mod
actions.work: Install in the supported game and exercise onboarding, meaningful play, save/reload and disable/update behavior.
actions.acceptance: Actual game/version/profile evidence and retained failure recordings; no invented standalone app requirement.

actions.title: Verify release provenance and UX
actions.work: Connect producer/source identity to the downloadable package and capture honest player-facing visuals and instructions.
actions.acceptance: Public claims match the artifact; configuration and data ownership survive update/removal.

actions.title: Repair artifact selection, not by deleting artifacts
actions.work: Inspect cargo metadata, target/profile/environment configuration; explicitly build both required binaries and pass emitted paths from Cargo JSON or a validated artifact manifest into the harness. Do not clean between build and execution.
actions.acceptance: Both exact executables exist before launch; a missing target fails clearly; the actual harness advances past precheck. Native proof is still required.

actions.title: Run the real game witness
actions.work: Use the accepted required assets/audio/render profile; create a populated world, interact, save, quit, reopen and exercise restart/reconnect.
actions.acceptance: Authentic gameplay captures, assertions and failed attempts tied to current binaries; no missing-baseline or no-image success.

actions.title: Protect long-lived world semantics
actions.work: Check new populated fields and future state additions through save/reload and bounded unattended continuation; reconcile old global-determinism/product copy.
actions.acceptance: No silent state loss; selective reproducibility contracts retained; installed player and visual review qualify the same candidate.

actions.title: Bind the real integration target
actions.work: Return active worktree/task, supported game version, loader/bridge version and actual installable pack.
actions.acceptance: A current worker receipt and source-to-game artifact map.

actions.title: Complete one actual pack journey
actions.work: Create/load a useful pack, inspect real gameplay effects, handle conflict/reload/restart and disable/uninstall cleanly.
actions.acceptance: Recorded in-game behavior plus negative conflict and missing-asset tests.

actions.title: Compare authoring and reuse
actions.work: Implement the same small change using the ordinary supported modding path; reuse loader/asset/test facilities where they preserve behavior.
actions.acceptance: Measured authoring/debugging burden, compatibility and frame-time effects; no claims based on SDK line count.

actions.title: Identify the shipped binary
actions.work: Map real executable/build root and owned upstream delta; compare the installed version with the claimed candidate.
actions.acceptance: A clean install launches the intended fork, not a harness-only package or upstream binary.

actions.title: Complete a controlled coding task
actions.work: Read permitted source, change one feature, run meaningful tests, deny prohibited writes, interrupt and resume.
actions.acceptance: Task outcome and side effects are correct; source/profile/artifact and failure receipts attached.

actions.title: Close update and upstream contracts
actions.work: Update the fork from a supported installed version and test preserved sessions/settings and rollback; compare with upstream on the same task.
actions.acceptance: Upgrade does not overwrite unrelated data; owned value is separated from inherited features.

actions.title: Inventory all effective compiler profiles
actions.work: Map each supported package, app, test and generated segment to the intended type/lint/build job; document precise exclusions.
actions.acceptance: No supported code disappears without another checker or an accepted reason; known bad inputs fail.

actions.title: Close scoped remaining errors and actual UX
actions.work: Reproduce the current diagnostics, fix real code defects without relaxing contracts, and exercise the accepted workbench/config workflow.
actions.acceptance: Clean selected build and a real persisted useful task; no percentage derived from excluded files.

actions.title: Qualify cross-product configuration contracts
actions.work: Compare local custom configuration and session facilities with existing owned or mature components; test secrets and updates.
actions.acceptance: Dependencies resolve from a clean environment, secrets stay private, consumers retain semantics and the install works.

actions.title: Reconcile current work and gate ownership
actions.work: Return active branch/artifact and classify actual current-head required failures; preserve already merged promotion work.
actions.acceptance: Exact blocker IDs, owners and wakeup conditions; no replay of completed work.

actions.title: Prove resilient installed execution
actions.work: Run matched coding tasks with stream interruption, tool error, child failure, restart and session recovery.
actions.acceptance: No duplicate mutation, lost answer or incorrect workspace access; actual output and retry histories retained.

actions.title: Deliver and compare the owned binary
actions.work: Verify Mac/Windows channels as applicable, update/rollback and upstream identity; compare current fork with KCode/upstream on the same failures.
actions.acceptance: Installed and tested artifact are identical; continuity advantage is measured rather than asserted.

actions.title: Reconcile reported failures and installed fork
actions.work: Locate actual failing cases, environment and source identity; distinguish reporting state from the real process/tool state.
actions.acceptance: All mandatory failures have reproduced repair or explicit approved exception; no percentage-based pass.

actions.title: Exercise restart and duplicate-event safety
actions.work: Force stream failures, child restarts, duplicate notifications and termination around sensitive tool calls.
actions.acceptance: State recovers honestly; side effects are not duplicated; destructive operations remain separately authorized.

actions.title: Qualify release and peer comparison
actions.work: Install owned binaries on actual target systems, test updates, memory use and a matched upstream/HeliosLite task.
actions.acceptance: Clean launch, recovery and measured resource claims on the distributed artifact, not only a source build.

actions.title: Identify owned delta and distribution
actions.work: Return exact worktree/source base, local patches, intended role (standalone/embedded) and installed build.
actions.acceptance: Clear upstream/owned feature and compatibility map.

actions.title: Run the terminal correctness corpus
actions.work: Exercise Unicode, input/IME, resize, alternate-screen, paste, shell integration and high-volume output using real native UI.
actions.acceptance: No regressions against upstream on mandatory terminal semantics; native captures and diagnostics.

actions.title: Prove the actual differentiated use
actions.work: Qualify the embedding/integration or workflow the fork exists for, including lifecycle and updates.
actions.acceptance: A useful owned outcome with reproducible performance and safe update behavior.

actions.title: Reconcile site and profile ownership
actions.work: Map actual profile README, landing/build roots, public subjects and approved source records; coordinate .github/registry without duplicating authority.
actions.acceptance: One truthful publication inventory with private/public separation.

actions.title: Build and deploy the actual surface
actions.work: Verify the existing authorized Vercel/Pages/domain setup, relative paths, deep links, search and static assets for selected routes.
actions.acceptance: Current source-to-artifact-to-route receipt and rollback; no inferred DNS changes.

actions.title: Publish actual product proof
actions.work: Use authentic tested packages, screenshots/VHS and compatibility notes; label concepts/fixtures.
actions.acceptance: An unfamiliar user can discover, install and assess an actual product without misleading links or claims.

actions.title: Type and label backend outcomes
actions.work: Separate live render, placeholder, job-spec-only, unavailable and failed outputs; ensure release/product acceptance cannot silently consume fixture output as production.
actions.acceptance: Known absent backend, failed render and malformed/zero-duration media are rejected or explicitly blocked; rehearsal stays runnable.

actions.title: Run real creative output
actions.work: Import an actual licensed audio track, use the intended available renderer, edit the scene/preset, export and inspect audio/video synchronization and content.
actions.acceptance: Real output reviewed, not only a ZIP/nonempty file; actual run parameters and derivatives are traceable.

actions.title: Qualify installation and comparison
actions.work: Run outside the repo, reopen projects and recover interrupted rendering; compare time-to-useful-output with a suitable established workflow.
actions.acceptance: Repeatable actual creative result plus qualitative and resource measurements; no inflated completion from fixture success.

actions.title: Verify handler dispatch parity
actions.work: Diff the extracted paths and run contract tests for all affected provider categories, auth modes, status codes, partial streams and cancellation.
actions.acceptance: Before/after behavior preserved on defined cases; no fallback converts errors into success.

actions.title: Run a realistic routing stress/fault workload
actions.work: Exercise quotas, credential scope, retries, timeouts and backpressure under actual concurrency with bounded provider usage.
actions.acceptance: Correct failover/accounting and tail-latency/resource results, with negative cases retained.

actions.title: Qualify actual deployed fork
actions.work: Identify the running source/build/config and update/rollback channel; reconcile upstream owned delta.
actions.acceptance: A real installation uses the tested handlers and honors consumer contract through deployment.

actions.title: Build the per-application atlas
actions.work: Inventory each app entrypoint, domain, manifest, data/secret ownership, packaging and consumer; distinguish recovered snapshots from integrated runnable apps.
actions.acceptance: Every material app has a disposition, active source, missing-obligation record and exact owner; unknown is not discarded.

actions.title: Complete one runnable app without blocking the collection
actions.work: Select the nearest accepted useful application and qualify install/onboarding/state/recovery. Keep unrelated applications independently buildable.
actions.acceptance: Real role-specific CVP and clean isolated build; no collection-wide completeness claim.

actions.title: Refine shared boundaries with PhenoShared
actions.work: Move only approved stable shared capabilities through contract-tested adapters; preserve each application semantics and private data.
actions.acceptance: Consumer acceptance and provenance retained; no speculative framework or global version lockstep.

actions.title: Locate actual source and consumers
actions.work: Reconcile local/branch asset work, tokens, components, design guidance and consumed package versions.
actions.acceptance: One source/export/consumer map with licenses, privacy and revision identity.

actions.title: Qualify one real cross-product design change
actions.work: Apply a bounded shared token/component/asset improvement through actual exports to a native/web product and its docs/landing.
actions.acceptance: No accessibility, text contrast, performance or required theme regression; editable sources retained.

actions.title: Produce honest product media
actions.work: Use real installed-app screenshots or VHS for proof; separately author 2D/2.5D/3D branding and motion with static/reduced-motion fallbacks.
actions.acceptance: Evidence and concept assets clearly separated; export recipe, alt text, source rights and resource budgets recorded.

actions.title: Qualify the actual authentication contract
actions.work: Test success, denial, cancellation, expired session, unavailable network and native callback; compare expected local/offline behavior with accepted policy.
actions.acceptance: No demo success, credential leak or irrecoverable login loop; actual scoped user state.

actions.title: Prove one real two-node path
actions.work: Use genuine producer/consumer endpoints and negotiated capabilities with cancellation, disconnect/reconnect and correct focus/input/output ownership.
actions.acceptance: End-to-end transport and effects observed; no graph-only fixture stands in for working devices.

actions.title: Demonstrate locality and contention behavior
actions.work: Choose shared-memory/local transport where supported and qualified network adapters otherwise; measure tail latency, quality and foreground impact.
actions.acceptance: No hidden copies/queues or unsupported capability passes; actual Mac/PC workflow proof and dependency contracts.

actions.title: Return the actual experiment/run identity
actions.work: Resolve branch, dataset/model/config/environment, execution location and saved outputs.
actions.acceptance: Exact native-run or explicit not-run status; no status inferred from suite inventory.

actions.title: Run positive and known-negative benchmark cases
actions.work: Use a small representative workload with real runner, tool/environment limits and independently specified expected behavior.
actions.acceptance: Bad candidate fails; infra failure remains separate; costs/logs/seeds/configuration preserved.

actions.title: Reconcile shared extraction and reproducibility
actions.work: Coordinate reused runner/library code with Portage and PhenoShared; retain lab-specific scenario ownership and real data provenance.
actions.acceptance: Another isolated environment can reproduce the bounded experiment without hidden workstation dependencies.

actions.title: Resolve field-level authority
actions.work: Map live GitHub facts, accepted identities/roles, source docs, mutable work and generated views. Record what PhenoShared moved and what stays authoritative here.
actions.acceptance: One writer/owner per governed field; no duplicate registry inferred from package names.

actions.title: Refresh the actual non-zz dispatch map
actions.work: Bind stable repository IDs, current names/default branches and one user-reported owner chat; record missing/unavailable separately from deleted.
actions.acceptance: Every current subject maps to one current folder and receipt; a rename preserves identity.

actions.title: Make projections truthful and reproducible
actions.work: Generate topical views and public metadata from approved records; detect source contradictions and validate links/private-data boundaries.
actions.acceptance: Known stale/conflicting records are surfaced; no invented approval or completion percentage.

actions.title: Reconcile source identity and package inventory
actions.work: Index all languages/build systems, members, excluded packages and recovered copies. Assign retained/integrated/fixture/archive/unsupported status and source lineage by repository ID.
actions.acceptance: No file-presence or compilation-only absorption verdict; each retained public capability has a real owner/consumer/profile.

actions.title: Close one donor-to-consumer dependency slice
actions.work: Select a registry or runtime capability, establish authoritative API/source, resolve equivalent local/upstream dependency identity, and test a clean real consumer.
actions.acceptance: Cache-isolated fetch/build plus semantic and failure tests; excluded Python contract explicitly restored, deprecated by approval or blocked.

actions.title: Establish package-level release and reuse discipline
actions.work: Build/publish only authorized independent packages with bounded dependency cones. Qualify actual consumers, updates and rollback; adapt trusted tools rather than copying weak implementations.
actions.acceptance: Current/future-consumer impact record, compatibility evidence, no lockstep all-workspace dependency, no unrelated repo mutation.

actions.title: Reconcile exact owned upstream delta
actions.work: Record upstream source/revision, local patches, imported results and current build.
actions.acceptance: Each result has producer/source provenance; imported evidence is not represented as a new local run.

actions.title: Run matched positive/negative tasks
actions.work: Use identical real tasks on the owned fork and upstream; inject timeout, missing tool, incorrect answer and cleanup interruption.
actions.acceptance: Trustworthy result classification and retained artifacts; no required oracle silently skipped.

actions.title: Qualify install and shared consumers
actions.work: Install the fork cleanly; exercise PhenoLab/current consumer interfaces, cancellation, storage/cleanup and resource limits.
actions.acceptance: Consumer contract remains compatible after upstream sync with measured benefit or justified patch value.

actions.title: Qualify removed public and internal surfaces
actions.work: Use the exact final PR diff and before/after exported API/CLI inventory; identify consumer references and approved retirement/compatibility decisions.
actions.acceptance: No required behavior silently removed; replaced/moved capability has qualified successor and migration evidence.

actions.title: Prove the real supervisor under contention
actions.work: Run dissimilar/similar tasks, cancellation, retries, crash cleanup and credential/cache isolation while protecting foreground audio/game use.
actions.acceptance: Semantic equivalence and relevant latency/resource benefits survive cleanup; honest independent assurance reports.

actions.title: Resolve reusable ownership and ship
actions.work: Coordinate mirrored/copied packages and Substrate dependencies with PhenoShared, then install/update the current CLI/tray outside source.
actions.acceptance: One authoritative writer or explicit sync contract; real consumer tests and distributed-artifact identity.

actions.title: Establish one current bounded product-model path
actions.work: Reuse the atlas/source records already available; identify actual import, entity/relationship persistence, bounded navigation and discrepancy paths.
actions.acceptance: A real repo/capability maps to source/requirements and a genuine discrepancy with correct evidence, not only sample JSON.

actions.title: Close durability and consistent interfaces
actions.work: Exercise update/reconcile, provenance, unsupported/unknown cases, restart and the same scoped model via UI/CLI/MCP/API.
actions.acceptance: State and identity survive restart; tool boundaries respect their actual owners; stale data is visible.

actions.title: Qualify real deployment and independent acceptance
actions.work: Repair current hosted errors within authorized scope, install/deploy the real frontend/backend, and compare the task with a competent manual/tool baseline.
actions.acceptance: Artifact/source/config/route evidence and independent negative oracles; no work-item dashboard substituted for the product.

actions.title: Return the actual owner work receipt
actions.work: Identify this chat's current repo/worktree, whether it still owns this product, and any delegated all-game infrastructure tasks.
actions.acceptance: No work falsely attributed here; linked infrastructure ownership and next product action are clear.

actions.title: Qualify the true rendering candidate
actions.work: Install the supported game/mod combination and required assets; test terrain, actors, shape/LOD/camera behavior and save/reload.
actions.acceptance: Native captures and measured frame pacing/memory plus real negative cases; no disabled feature described as delivered.

actions.title: Compare and preserve upstream semantics
actions.work: Use matched populated scenes against upstream/baseline and test coexistence, update, disable and recovery.
actions.acceptance: Measured visual value and explicit trade-offs without broken game state or unsafe dependency replacement.
